reason: Reviewed the combined OpenClaw generation fencing and Hermes prompt plugin against the packaged Notifai skill, harness setup and update references, CLI readiness and Doctor, README, TRUST, and protocol Agent Session and Source Context terms. The OpenClaw references explain that sessionId can stay fixed across /new and /reset, that Notifai activates once per observed generation, and that agents should reread changed guidance in an already activated generation. Hermes v0.21.5 local classic CLI gains owner-managed activation and Source Context while asynchronous ask remains unsupported; its prompt budget invokes the bounded fallback directing the agent to run notifai guidance before notifying. The Hermes plugin requests no privileged capabilities and refuses foreign files and same-name entry points before adapter mutation; Doctor treats unsupported Hermes question settings as optional. Parent Notification Request ownership, User guidance authority, acknowledgement, non-exfiltration, and domain terminology remain intact.
